candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes a child with proportionate short stature, frontal bossing, large open anterior fontanel, micrognathia, and skeletal survey findings of diffuse osteosclerosis, biconvex vertebrae, Wormian bones, and acro-osteolysis of the distal phalanges. These are classic features of Pycnodysostosis. The candidate includes 'short stature' which is a prominent feature in the case and a known manifestation of the condition.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: The candidate identifies the core diagnosis and a key manifestation.
